messages:
eva: FYI I just triaged a DAST finding in staging — shows a 3rd-party test API key in responses from /internal/metrics. Not exposed in prod, but still a gap. :warning:
sec-bot: automated-scan run at 2027-04-21T15:12Z — DAST ID: DAST-20270421-09, severity: MEDIUM, url: https://staging.redwood.example/internal/metrics, evidence: response body contains 'X-TEST-KEY'
sam: ugh. where did that key live? env? config?
eva: looks like a hardcoded fixture in tests that got bundled into the staging image via build artifact. not a real secret, but confuses our leak detection and could leak to logs.
maria: thanks for the heads-up. two tracks: (1) short-term remove/rotate any real creds, (2) process changes so scanners don't flag known test fixtures. we need auditability for any suppressions.
james: can we gate suppressions behind an RFC and an audit log entry? we should never allow blanket suppressions without owner + expiry.
eva: agreed. propose: suppression PR must include: owner, justification, expiry (max 90d), and a link to failing scan. record suppression in central audit index (append-only).
sam: infra question: the DAST runner currently needs read access to staging artifacts to reproduce. Do we give it a role on S3/artifact-bucket or create ephemeral credentials?
maria: ephemeral is better. Create a service principal for scan-runner and grant STS AssumeRole for 1h. Avoid long-lived keys.
james: add KMS policy too — scanner needs to decrypt test fixtures when reproducing but should not be able to use the KMS key for anything else. least privilege.
eva: current KMS key is broad. I can open a ticket to create a dedicated scanning-key with key policy: "Allow: scan-service:Decrypt on key-arn" and CMK usage logs forwarded to audit logging.
sam: for RBAC, maybe a namespaced role: scan-runner@staging with s3:GetObject, s3:ListBucket, sts:AssumeRole. No PutObject.
maria: also: export DAST/SAST findings to our SIEM so suppression events and who approved them are searchable for 365d. retention requirement from compliance.
eva: action list: 1) remove fixture from build (eva) 2) create ephemeral scan-runner principal + IAM policy (sam) 3) new KMS key + limited policy + audit export (james) 4) suppression workflow doc + PR template + audit index (maria) 5) pipeline change to run DAST only on staging with masked logs (eva)
sec-bot: noted: created incident INC-20270421-5, assigned to eva, severity: LOW-MED, sla: 72h
sam: quick CI snippet to avoid bundling tests into image — add to .github/workflows/build.yml:
```
- name: build image
  run: docker build --file Dockerfile --build-arg INCLUDE_TESTS=false .
```

maria: and a sample IAM attach we can use as a starting point:
```
aws iam create-role --role-name scan-runner-staging --assume-role-policy-document file://trust.json
aws iam put-role-policy --role-name scan-runner-staging --policy-name S3ReadOnlyForScanner --policy-document file://scanner-policy.json
```

eva: who can own the suppression audit index implementation? want an append-only table in infra/db with fields: suppression_id, owner, justification, expiry_ts, approver, created_ts.
james: infra-eyes: I can prototype with retained logs forwarding to SIEM + small DynamoDB table for suppressions. I'll pair with maria on schema.
sam: one more ask: can we have the scanner append a trace id to any evidence it records so we can map back to a run? e.g., X-SCAN-RUN: DAST-20270421-09.
maria: yes please. add to scanner config. also mask returned keys in logs with `***` before sending to SIEM.
eva: ok I'll start the fix PR now and create the suppression PR template in docs. tagging @james and @sam for the infra/KMS work.
james: noted. I'll draft KMS policy and open PR for the scan-role.
sam: will do ephemeral role + CI change. ETA EOD tomorrow.
maria: I'll write the suppression workflow and add the audit export requirement to compliance checklist.
eva: thanks all :sparkles: keep this thread for updates, we'll close INC after all items done.
